name: How long does an open-concept kitchen conversion typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an open-concept kitchen conversion typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an open-concept kitchen conversion varies significantly based on the project's scope, including structural modifications, plumbing, electrical work, and finish selections. A typical conversion in the Los Angeles area can range from 8 to 16 weeks. This timeline includes design, permitting, demolition, construction, and final installation. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront, factoring in all necessary steps to ensure transparency and efficient progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: An open-concept kitchen conversion typically takes 8 to 16 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and scope.
